kok_tobe.name: Kok Tobe Tower
kok_tobe.price_text: Cable car and tower entry charged separately · check prices on the day
kok_tobe.hours: Cable car roughly 10:00–22:00 · check on the day
kok_tobe.tip: Ride the cable car up from the Dostyk end and walk the hilltop for city views.

ascension_cathedral.name: Ascension Cathedral
ascension_cathedral.hours: Open daily, roughly 07:00–19:00 · check on the day
ascension_cathedral.tip: One of the tallest wooden churches in the world. Visit early to avoid crowds.

central_museum.name: Central State Museum of Kazakhstan
central_museum.price_text: Small entry fee · check price on the day
central_museum.tip: Start on the top floor and work down; the golden warrior and nomad halls are the highlight.

zelionyj_bazar.name: Zelionyj Bazar
zelionyj_bazar.price_text: Free to enter · pay for what you buy
zelionyj_bazar.tip: Come hungry for dried fruit, nuts and fresh bread. Bring small cash notes.

golden_warrior.name: Golden Warrior Monument
golden_warrior.tip: The statue sits on a tall plinth in Republic Square. Good photo stop on the way to the mountains.

panfilov_park.name: Panfilov Park walk
panfilov_park.tip: Shady paths around the cathedral and war memorial. A calm break between sights.

green_bazaar_food.name: Bazaar snack stop
green_bazaar_food.tip: Grab samsa and tea at the small counters around the bazaar.

medeu.name: Medeu skating rink
medeu.price_text: Skate rental and entry charged · check on the day
medeu.tip: High mountain rink above the city. Bring warm layers even in summer.
medeu.best: Winter for skating; any clear day for views

shymbulak.name: Shymbulak cable car
shymbulak.price_text: Cable car ticket charged · check on the day
shymbulak.tip: Ride up for alpine views and short walks. Weather can close the top station.

big_alamy.name: Big Almaty Lake day trip
big_alamy.price_text: Tour or taxi · price varies, check on the day
big_alamy.hours: Daylight hours · border permit may be needed
big_alamy.tip: Turquoise mountain lake. Go with a tour or driver; the road is rough.
big_alamy.best: Summer and early autumn, morning start

arbat_walk.name: Arbat pedestrian street
arbat_walk.tip: Street art, cafes and buskers. Good for an easy evening stroll.

green_hill.name: Kok Tobe hill viewpoint
green_hill.tip: Walk past the tower for quieter city and mountain views.

food_tour.name: Central Asian food walk
food_tour.price_text: Guided tours vary · check on the day
food_tour.tip: Try beshbarmak, lagman and baursak. Ask the guide about local tea houses.

opera_house.name: Abay Opera House
opera_house.price_text: Ticket prices vary · check on the day
opera_house.tip: Check the programme for ballet or opera. Book a few days ahead.

metro_tour.name: Almaty metro ride
metro_tour.price_text: Cheap single fare · pay per ride
metro_tour.tip: The stations are decorated with marble and mosaics. A cheap way to see local life.

mountain_walk.name: Almaty mountain foothill walk
mountain_walk.tip: Easy trails above the city. Wear proper shoes and carry water.

tea_house.name: Local tea house stop
tea_house.tip: Order tea with baursak and watch the room. Cash is handy.

city_walk.name: Golden Quarter evening walk
city_walk.tip: Loop between the opera house, Arbat and the main squares after dark.
